california_coast_trip.trip_name: Southbound Highway 1 - San Francisco to Los Angeles
california_coast_trip.style: 3 riding days, camping, road bike, ~05:00 starts

totals.method: BRouter velo_pch_road.brf on OpenStreetMap (correctMisplacedViaPoints on); one 391 m permissive-profile leg at the Winchester Canyon US-101 tagging gap; rebuilt 2026-08-04 after removing 62 km of via-point out-and-back spurs

stages.name: Day 1 - San Francisco to Limekiln State Park
stages.warning: Rocky Creek Bridge one-way signal control at km 235, 24/7 through 31 Aug 2026, up to 15 min.

stages.name: Day 2 - Limekiln State Park to Refugio State Beach
stages.warning: Thinnest resupply of the three days. Fill up in Lompoc at km 226 - the next 34 km over the Santa Rosa Hills has nothing.

stages.name: Day 3 - Refugio State Beach to LA Union Station
stages.warning: Last ~50 km runs through the Palisades Fire rebuild corridor on PCH: one lane each way, 25 mph.

variants_built: pch_day1_alt_pfeiffer.gpx (256.1 km - stop in Big Sur Village instead of pressing on)
open_actions: DECIDE camping: book Limekiln on ReserveCalifornia 800-444-7275 (no walk-up sites exist), OR camp wild - dispersed camping on Los Padres NF land is legal and permit-free, but campfires are banned until 31 Jan 2027 and the NF land is east of and above Highway 1
CHECK Caltrans QuickMap on the morning - Rocky Creek Bridge one-way control runs 24/7 through 31 Aug 2026
CHECK the Vandenberg launch schedule for your date - CA-1 past the base can close at a few hours' notice
BOOK the bicycle on the Coast Starlight out of LA Union Station - separate reservation, limited space
GET a free California Campfire Permit if carrying a stove

optional_extension._verdict: Works and needs no new bookings; flattest and best-supplied day of the trip; least interesting riding. See EXTENSIONS.md.
optional_extension.name: Day 4 - Los Angeles to San Diego
optional_extension.crux: Camp Pendleton. 27 km of coast is Marine Corps base. Through the base needs a DBIDS Recreational Bicycle pass, in person only at the Visitor Center by the Main Gate at the OCEANSIDE end, Mon/Tue/Thu/Fri 07:30-15:30 and Wed 07:45-15:30 - unobtainable en route southbound. The Caltrans-permitted I-5 shoulder (Basilone Rd to Oceanside, exits 62-54) bypasses it and measures the same: 36.14 km vs 36.06 km. Default GPX takes the I-5 line; pch_day4_alt_pendleton.gpx takes the base if you hold the pass.
optional_extension.camping_warning: Hiker/biker sites at San Onofre, San Clemente and South Carlsbad State Beaches are reported ELIMINATED; only San Elijo #94 remains (FCFS after 16:00, vacate 09:00, one night, $10/person). Ride LA-San Diego in ONE day rather than planning to camp partway.

border_option.note: Santa Fe Depot to Border Field SP, the end of the Pacific Coast Bike Route. Bicycles cannot use the San Diego-Coronado Bridge: the GPX goes round the bay (26.0 km), or take the Coronado ferry from Broadway Pier and the Silver Strand (24.8 km incl. a 2.4 km boat).

optional_extension.return_home: Pacific Surfliner from Santa Fe Depot (FREE bike reservation, 7 roll-on spaces) to LA, then Coast Starlight north (6 bikes, books out) - one transfer MORE than finishing at LA. Offset: San Diego airport is 5 km from the depot.

alternatives_considered.verdict: BEST RIDING of any extension and tailwind-correct, but needs the Amtrak San Joaquins Thruway Bus Route 7 to Leggett with a bike space that is first-come-first-served, not reservable. Not realistic two days out.
Half a day, most of the quality, no bus needed.
Nearly free prologue / shakedown over the Golden Gate.

alternatives_considered.option: Loop home inland LA -> Central Valley -> SF
alternatives_considered.verdict: NO. As long as the whole southbound trip, and Fresno was forecast an 11-day run of 103-108F (39-42C) for early Aug 2026 with NWS moderate-to-major heat risk. Heat-injury exposure, not a hard day.
